Reducing chronically elevated inflammatory levels with nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs has been shown to restore muscle protein anabolism and significantly reduce muscle loss in aging rats (187). Moreover, physical activity displays an inverse correlation with low-grade systemic inflammation (163): The acute elevation of ILs enhances anabolism, whereas the suppression of chronic IL production mitigates catabolic processes.
